build_LitEma_ema_wrapper: build a LitEma wrapper for a PyTorch model with configurable decay and shadow parameter tracking
run_LitEma_forward_update: run the LitEma forward pass to update shadow parameters using exponential moving average
create_LitEma_copy_to: create a copy of EMA shadow parameters back into the original model using copy_to
test_LitEma_store_restore: test the LitEma store and restore methods to temporarily save and recover model parameters
review_LitEma_initialization: review the LitEma class initialization to understand decay validation and buffer registration for shadow parameters
